issues.description: Page is stuck in loading state - never transitions to showing the AI-redesigned room image and before/after slider. The loading animation appears to be infinite with no completion logic or timeout.
issues.root_cause: The loading state in apps/web/app/design/step-8a/page.tsx likely has no mechanism to advance through loading steps and resolve to the result view. The steps probably cycle forever or the condition to show the result never becomes true (e.g., missing mock data, no simulated render completion, or the isLoading flag never flips to false).

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors causing full client-side re-render. 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors indicate time-dependent or random values rendered during SSR differ from client render.
issues.root_cause: The loading step text or progress indicator likely uses Date.now(), Math.random(), or similar non-deterministic values during render, causing SSR/client mismatch. The step-3 page also has an aria-label hydration mismatch ('Progress 5 percent' vs 'Progress 15 percent') indicating similar pattern exists across pages.

issues.description: Before/after slider and redesigned room image are completely absent - the primary deliverable of step-8a is not shown at all.
